intro: A Visitor to Dun Morogh is an investigative task offered by Beldin Steelgrill outside Kharanos. Mountaineers reported an unfamiliar campfire high on the cliffs overlooking Gol'Bolar Quarry, prompting a scout to check whether the stranger poses a threat to the local dwarves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... Well, you know what to do.
